_comment: Live-watched. Save this file and the running shell re-themes; no restart.
Every value below is the shipped default, written out so the file
doubles as the documentation. Delete any key to fall back to it.
See Commons/Theme.qml for ranges and what each knob actually does.
font.family is the UI/body family only. The icon family is pinned to a
Nerd Font in code and is intentionally not settable here: pointing it
elsewhere does not blank the glyphs, it silently draws different ones.
font.size is the base of the whole scale - type, spacing and the bar
grid are all derived from it, so this one number rescales the shell.
palette.* condition pywal's colors.json rather than replace it. The
wallpaper stays the colour source; these decide how it is interpreted.
